source_row.rationale: CMS Conditions for Coverage for dialysis facilities address comprehensive standards including patient care, infection control, water quality, and quality assessment/performance improvement, reflecting the unique and significant safety considerations specific to dialysis care delivery.
source_row.source_detail: Scope of Dialysis Facility Regulatory Requirements
